# Judge a shorter review suggestion by its actual root-child semantics

D214186 reviewer offered a shorter root-count subtraction, but the author changed it to avoid false negatives and added hasNew handling/tests. Landed/current logic adjusts the lone unread/new-root case. Keep unread/new root properties separate from descendant flags and verify the matrix before accepting arithmetic simplification. A requested snippet is evidence of discussion, not automatically the final rule.

Scope: mailnews/base/src.
